items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: Was it Jitney? Yeah, Jitney played the South.

ctx.x: They were just named the band after the place. Like when we were playing at the Levita, it was the Levita band. We were playing at the Foyne, it was the Foyne band. We played at the Alamo, it was the Alamo band. We played at the Alamo and the Levita. Where was the Alamo? The Alamo was on Canal in... Dauphine, Nethanale. Right where Grant is. Yeah, where Grant's now. Then you played at the Lake too.

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: Was it Jitney? Yeah, Jitney played the South. Then you played at the Lake of Water.

We played at the Gypsy Tea Garden out at Millenburg. Japanese Tea Garden. Japanese Tea Garden. For Vivalvo. Yeah, Japanese... Was that one of those camps out on the water? That's where everybody used to play with... I told you it was Saeed, Bail, and Bigfoot, Bill, and Liz Gallo. That's not the one on the photograph. No, no, that was just a gathering of people. Yeah. The Japanese Tea Garden was right at the beginning of the water. Here was the Japanese Tea Garden and the water started right over there. Ah, now…
